'''Koong Island''' was an island in the [[Roon Sea]] on [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] which was used as a base by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong's]] faction of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of [[Tawntoom]] province during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
